about.description: Single-stock perpetual market tracking NVIDIA Corporation. Users get linear exposure to NVIDIA share-price moves without owning NVIDIA shares, shareholder rights, or dividend claims. Pricing uses Felix's external reference methodology for equity markets. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDH. Markets are visible on Hyperliquid under the flx namespace, but are operated by Felix rather than listed as core Hyperliquid perps.
